description: Uncached one-point MSM calldata production on 20 seeded full-width scalars per curve and subgroup points (i+1)G; Python includes typed serialization and Rust includes FFI+serialization. Five repeats per input; one untimed warmup per input/backend. Cached hint data is cleared outside timing. Median is the median of per-input medians.
rust_profile: release opt-level=3 with debug symbols (CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_DEBUG=1), Rust 1.97.0

commands.build: CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_DEBUG=1 RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.97.0 VIRTUAL_ENV="$PWD/venv" PATH="$PWD/venv/bin:$PATH" uv run --python venv/bin/python --no-project maturin develop --release --features python > /tmp/garaga-glv-native-final.log 2>&1

post_measurement_changes: Root added Python ValueError fallback for unsupported composite-modulus parameters. All six benchmark curves use supported prime orders, whose executed path is unchanged. Rust changes after the measured native build add four tests and formatting only; production Rust logic is unchanged. Measured source hashes remain preserved.
